Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: lukasWuttke
Message:
feat(ingest): end-to-end ingest correlation id — honour the Job env (backend#1028 item 3) (#368)

* feat(ingest): honour TRACEBLOC_INGEST_CORRELATION_ID as the end-to-end run id (backend#1028 item 3)

jobs-manager (client-runtime) stamps the CLI's idempotency key onto the
spawned ingestor Job as TRACEBLOC_INGEST_CORRELATION_ID — the same string
its Job name and tracebloc.io/ingestion-run label already derive from.
Pick it up here:

- utils/correlation.py: resolve + validate the env value (1-64 chars of
  [A-Za-z0-9._-], mirroring jobs-manager's key cap and label alphabet).
  Absent -> None; malformed -> WARNING + None. Observability must never
  fail an ingest.
- BaseIngestor: keep the id ALONGSIDE the per-process ingestor_id (row
  scoping — label counts, the #227 compensating delete — must stay
  per-process across Job retries, or a hard-killed attempt's orphan rows
  would be counted into the retry's dataset). Riding file_options puts it
  in the registration payload's meta_data, so the backend dataset row
  carries it verbatim (DictField, no backend change needed).
- cli/run.py: print the always-visible link line
  "Correlation id: <id> (ingestor_id: <uuid>)" — print, not logger,
  because the default LOG_LEVEL is WARNING.

No env set = today's behaviour, byte for byte.
